Super Eagles duo Alex Iwobi and Calvin Bassey set new Fulham landmarks as the Cottagers held Manchester City to a 1-1 draw at the Etihad Stadium on Saturday, PUNCH Sports Extra reports. Iwobi made his 100th Premier League start for Fulham, becoming the first African player to reach that figure for the London club, according to the Premier League. The former Everton midfielder, who joined in the summer of 2023, has made 122 league appearances for Fulham, scoring 20 goals and providing 12 assists. The 30-year-old was booked in the first half and replaced by Antonee Robinson with 20 minutes remaining. Bassey captained Fulham and played the full 90 minutes as they earned their first Premier League point at the Etihad in 13 visits. The result also ended City’s 17-match winning run against Fulham in the competition. The defender had lost all four of his previous meetings with City since joining Fulham, conceding 15 goals in games that finished 4-0, 3-2, 5-4 and 3-0. Saturday’s draw ended that 924-day run. Elliot Anderson levelled in the 57th minute. Bassey, who has been linked with a move to Manchester United, helped limit City to two shots on target from 14 attempts. He also forced a save from Gianluigi Donnarumma in the 69th minute after a forward run down the left, and almost turned Jérémy Doku’s cross into his own net in the 77th minute before Bernd Leno kept it out. Fulham have now lost only one of their eight league games, and Alvaro Arbeloa’s side sit three points above the bottom three.
